scope: All 218 issue bodies reviewed; selected local source inspected. Runtime reproduction and exhaustive comment review pending. Priorities describe reported impact, not confirmed defects. No upstream mutations.

priority_definitions.P1: Reported reliability, data integrity or access-control impact; reproduce early.
priority_definitions.P3: Feature and UX proposals requiring scope/design.

issues.rationale: The reported 2017–2021 copyright text differs from the core JSP footer; the screenshot alone does not establish which website owns it.
issues.next_step: Identify the screenshot URL and owning website repository, then update the date policy there.

issues.rationale: The failing intermine.webservice imports belong to the Python client, not the Java server.
issues.next_step: Check intermine/intermine-ws-python against supported Python versions and a clean install; link any existing client fix.

issues.rationale: The 500 involves MouseMine-specific fields, a private list and an omitted input dataframe; the server cause is unavailable.
issues.next_step: Obtain sanitized query XML, input sizes, deployment version and server exception; reduce against the MouseMine schema.

issues.rationale: The strict to_index > count clamp remains, and the server still calls subList(fromIdx, toIdx + 1); nine regions with page size ten exceed the end bound.
issues.next_step: Add a boundary regression for 0, 1, 9, 10 and 24 regions, including page-size changes, and validate server bounds.

issues.rationale: PathQueryBuilderForJSONObj still clears the supplied order and sorts by the inserted root id; only the simple-class exception branch restores the original order.
issues.next_step: Test ASC/DESC and nested JSON object grouping; define how requested root ordering coexists with grouping before changing the builder.

issues.rationale: This requests RDF alternate links in HTML and depends on the RDF URL design in #2379.
issues.next_step: Specify supported pages, canonical RDF URLs and content negotiation, then add link rendering coverage.

issues.rationale: The report gives a public KEGG example and BioDirectoryConverter workaround, but the advertised exception is absent from the issue body.
issues.next_step: Run the minimal KEGG BioFileConverter example with current source generation and collect the full integration exception.

issues.rationale: ExpressionSource, ExpressionSample and ExpressionValue are a proposed shared schema rather than a concrete failure.
issues.next_step: Compare participating mines, units, sample identifiers and strain relations, then agree a migration and loader contract.

issues.rationale: User enumeration and administrator assignment introduce privileged API behavior with no authorization contract specified.
issues.next_step: Design superuser-only operations, audit behavior and role-change invariants together with #2122 and #2123.

issues.rationale: R code generation requires coordination between the server codegen endpoint and the InterMineR API.
issues.next_step: Choose the supported InterMineR query syntax and add generated-code execution examples to the codegen acceptance criteria.

issues.rationale: Template sharing, collaborative editing and groups require a permissions model and conflict semantics.
issues.next_step: Define ownership, group membership, edit rights and revocation before schema or endpoint changes.

issues.rationale: The curator proposal adds publishing privileges and is coupled to superuser policy.
issues.next_step: Specify permitted template/list actions, assignment authority and migration alongside #2123 and #2436.

issues.rationale: Restricting every installation to one superuser changes administration semantics and existing accounts.
issues.next_step: Resolve whether the single-admin constraint is still desired and design migration and recovery behavior with the curator proposal.

issues.rationale: ObjectStoreSummary explicitly skips Substitution.overlappingFeatures and references #2423; the deployed performance effect is unverified.
issues.next_step: Verify the workaround is in the affected deployment and benchmark summarization while checking the intentionally non-empty field metadata.

issues.rationale: The report identifies an equality operator mismatch between column-summary filters and generated code, without a saved query or client version.
issues.next_step: Capture query JSON/XML after summary filtering and trace whether the invalid operator originates in bundled im-tables or core codegen.

issues.rationale: The report differs between FlyMine and HumanMine and uses facet_Organism while returned keys are organism.shortName, overlapping #2083.
issues.next_step: Compare deployed Solr facet configuration and exact keys, then test the documented filter key with an encoded organism value.

issues.rationale: Export ignores the selected filename in two JSP workflows; the issue lacks the browser and im-tables version.
issues.next_step: Capture download requests and Content-Disposition for list and result exports to locate the filename override.

issues.rationale: Only the title specifies permanent URLs in tablerows; there is no response example or compatibility requirement.
issues.next_step: Specify the affected response field and permanent identifier behavior for classes with and without stable identifiers.

issues.rationale: Fresh Gradle Cargo/Tomcat deployments reportedly need a second run, suggesting task ordering or startup readiness.
issues.next_step: Reproduce on a clean biotestmine with pinned Gradle/JDK/Tomcat versions and retain the first deployment logs and WAR timestamps.

issues.rationale: The request adds arbitrary-region FASTA output, including multiple regions, beyond overlapping-feature export.
issues.next_step: Specify coordinate conventions, bounds, strand, multi-region headers and behavior when sequence is unavailable.

issues.rationale: Region-search HTML still derives report links from webapp.baseurl, matching the described split between service and legacy UI hosts.
issues.next_step: Exercise separate service and legacy hosts and establish which configured base URL should build JSP report links.

issues.rationale: DataTracker still writes sourceName.length() and DataOutputStream.writeBytes(sourceName) into binary COPY; non-ASCII characters are not UTF-8 encoded.
issues.next_step: Add a PostgreSQL tracker round-trip with accented and supplementary characters, then use encoded byte lengths and UTF-8 bytes.

issues.rationale: The enrichment modal Create List control reportedly does nothing across mines, but no console error or current build is supplied.
issues.next_step: Repeat the widget flow with the shipped scripts, capture the click handler and API request, and test resulting list contents.

issues.rationale: The screenshot-based color request lacks measured contrast and an identified page/theme; changing white to grey is not itself a contrast specification.
issues.next_step: Identify the affected UI owner and measure text/background contrast before choosing accessible colors.

issues.rationale: Reactome enrichment is missing while KEGG works; no failing query or dataset/widget configuration is included.
issues.next_step: Inspect the affected mine’s Reactome pathway data, enrichment configuration and generated query to separate missing data from widget behavior.

issues.rationale: Silent empty complex records would affect scientific results; the PSI converter has format-dependent Complex handling and existing fixtures, but current failing input is absent.
issues.next_step: Run a retained failing PSI input through the converter and assert complex identifiers and participant counts before and after integration.

issues.rationale: Explicit pre-retrieve/retrieve/load actions reportedly all regenerate publications.xml, undermining resumable builds.
issues.next_step: Trace action dispatch for update-publications with a cached XML fixture and compare another source’s subaction behavior.

issues.rationale: LUI generation tries primaryIdentifier on classes such as Location that do not have that field; valid unsupported-class behavior is unspecified.
issues.next_step: Define an explicit unavailable-identifier outcome and distinguish unsupported classes from configuration errors in LUI resolution.

issues.rationale: The request changes the upload limit beyond 100000 entries without defining resource or timeout constraints.
issues.next_step: Measure identifier resolution cost, choose configurable limits and chunking behavior, and document upload versus query-created lists.

issues.rationale: Canonical UniProt isoform suffixes alter identifier semantics and cross-source integration keys.
issues.next_step: Agree accession versus isoform identifiers and migration rules, then test canonical and noncanonical matching across loaders.

issues.rationale: Unescaped trail pipes are a concrete legacy URL compatibility report, but the issue points to an older file layout.
issues.next_step: Inspect all current trail URL builders and test percent-encoded links under the supported Tomcat request parser.

issues.rationale: Downloading multi-gigabyte InterPro files before detecting duplicate releases wastes build time and bandwidth.
issues.next_step: Define release/version probing and cache validation for InterPro, including missing metadata and interrupted downloads.

issues.rationale: Friendly-mine links assume primaryIdentifier although custom model classes may expose another identifier.
issues.next_step: Test report pages with and without the required stable identifier and decide whether capabilities or class ancestry should gate the links.

issues.rationale: Coverage tooling is a maintenance proposal tied to obsolete Travis/Emma assumptions.
issues.next_step: Inventory current test execution first, then choose coverage collection and reporting that work with the agreed build modernization.

issues.rationale: A concrete distinct query sorts by a nonselected class field and is rejected by the objectstore.
issues.next_step: Reduce to a test-model query and determine the intended distinct-row ordering semantics before altering select expansion.

issues.rationale: Attribute rounding metadata needs a shared contract between webconfig_model and im-tables-3.
issues.next_step: Define precision, display-only versus export behavior and schema/API representation with the client consumer.

issues.rationale: Facet endpoints reportedly expose display labels instead of the machine keys required for filtering, with explicit mismatched responses.
issues.next_step: Add contract tests comparing facet-list, facet-search and quick-search keys; verify every returned key can be used as a filter.

issues.rationale: The esyn displayers stopped working after a remote-host change; embedded-content and endpoint compatibility are unverified.
issues.next_step: Check the current remote endpoint, iframe/embed policy and request errors on the affected deployment before changing core displayers.

issues.rationale: Template popularity counts omit API/BlueGenes usage; identifying a template by query name alone can misattribute requests.
issues.next_step: Specify verified template identity, uniqueness, token/privacy rules and which API operations count toward rankings.

issues.rationale: Broad FlyMine renaming mixes product-specific assumptions with copyright attribution and examples.
issues.next_step: Inventory runtime defaults separately from attribution and examples; agree rename scope before mechanical replacement.

issues.rationale: The remaining checklist centers on Python client compatibility and release work, with linked core CI follow-up.
issues.next_step: Verify the client repository’s supported Python matrix and release, then track only the current core CI dependency here.

issues.rationale: A proposed GWAS/Phenotype/GeneticMarker schema needs agreement across existing mine models and loaders.
issues.next_step: Compare HumanMine and LIS representations and settle phenotype, strain, marker and p-value semantics plus migration.

issues.rationale: The intermittent empty analysis page was not reproduced by the reporter and has no input or request trace.
issues.next_step: Capture a failing list input, authentication state, redirect chain and resulting bag state on a versioned deployment.

issues.rationale: The missing descriptions are specific FlyMine/HumanMine dataset metadata counts, not a demonstrated core parser defect.
issues.next_step: Audit current dataset descriptions and provenance in each mine’s static metadata source, then add completeness checks there.

issues.rationale: bio/sources/build.gradle now excludes org.apache.logging.log4j and uses reload4j; the reported Log4j PluginProcessor classpath may no longer exist.
issues.next_step: Run the dependency and compiler-warning checks on the current source build before deciding whether an annotationProcessor change remains necessary.

issues.rationale: A query referencing an inaccessible private list reportedly returns 500; the desired 403 also needs a deliberate information-disclosure policy.
issues.next_step: Test missing, private and authorized lists through query/results and agree consistent status/error mapping without leaking list existence.

issues.rationale: Using value instead of location for src.data.dir produces an unhelpful null filename error.
issues.next_step: Add a malformed source-property fixture and validate property kind before OBO conversion starts.

issues.rationale: Misnested project.xml properties reach execution and produce misleading model errors; a validation contract is needed.

issues.rationale: Missing gff3.seqClsName reportedly becomes a null model-class lookup instead of an actionable configuration error.

issues.next_step: Use the supplied PTGR2 row plus duplicate pair records to test type precedence, then inspect retained HumanMine integration provenance.

issues.rationale: Copying fails in HumanMine while FlyMine succeeds, and the remaining naming discrepancy is a separate UX concern.
issues.next_step: Capture the HumanMine exception and source list metadata, reproduce with the same list, and separate naming-policy changes.

issues.rationale: Template trail navigation followed by Edit Query has concrete steps and a TemplateAction null-pointer stack trace.
issues.next_step: Add a session-state regression for run-template, trail return and edit-query, retaining submitted form values.

issues.rationale: The request expands examples across language-client documentation repositories rather than changing the server.
issues.next_step: Assign the cookbook topics to each maintained client docs repository and validate executable examples against a test mine.

issues.rationale: Large unmatched identifier lists reportedly stall resolution; no benchmark sizes, timings or representative input are retained.
issues.next_step: Benchmark controlled matched/unmatched ratios and duplicate counts, then profile lookup queries and rejection handling.

issues.rationale: Index generation fails on null primary-key properties for Intron, but the triggering model/key configuration is absent.

issues.rationale: The only requirement is integration with the separate identifiers-widget project; there is no specified core behavior.

issues.next_step: Check the bundled imjs API and test invitation creation for an unregistered email with observable request/error handling.

issues.rationale: The report identifies a larger unminified im-tables asset, but the currently served bundle needs verification.

issues.rationale: The issue is an unanswered capability question with no required behavior or example.
issues.next_step: Determine current list-id query support with an authenticated API example, then document it or specify the missing endpoint behavior.

issues.next_step: Verify the deployed logo URL and proxy scheme handling; decide whether configuration validation would prevent recurrence.

issues.rationale: OpenID discovery is a proposed alternative to configured OAuth endpoint URLs.

issues.rationale: Sharing emails expose a Google provider identifier instead of a recognizable display name.
